design_issues.screen: AdminOps Fleet Allocation panel (Node Routing select)
issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. The Select component renders a <span data-ve-dynamic=true> inside <option> elements (AdminOps.jsx line ~218, fleet-node-select). Likely originates from Emergent's visual-editor instrumentation injecting a wrapper span into dynamic array-rendered options. Non-blocking — page renders and is usable — but it pollutes the console and may break SSR rehydration. Suggest investigating whether the editor instrumentation can be configured to skip <option> children, or wrap option text differently.

action_items: (LOW) Investigate the <span> inside <option> hydration warning on AdminOps fleet node select — appears to be Emergent editor instrumentation; main agent can decide whether to suppress or refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/deliverable.py demo-bypass logic on line 89 ('is_demo = job_id in (crown-demo, AD-KY041) or job.get(is_public_demo) is True') is concise and correct — contractor whose contractor_id != job.contractor_id is now permitted iff the job is a demo. Verified via test_contractor_bypass_can_load_crown_demo.

routes/quote_builder.py promote_quote_to_job correctly builds a pricing payload that matches the shape produced by _build_pricing in routes/deliverable.py — frontend deliverable page can consume promoted-quote pricing without branching.
routes/admin_ops.py sku-forecast aggregation pipeline correctly counts distinct quotes via $addToSet then len(set(...)) — handles duplicates across line items.

Frontend deck (DeliverableDeck.jsx) implements data-testid='deck-progress' + dot navigators + keyboard handlers as specified. Mobile responsiveness uses inline gridColumn: '1 / -1' to bypass Tailwind col-span quirk — verified mobile resolves to single track 358px.

Quote Builder UI surfaces the Save Quote action but the 'Promote to Job' dropdown only appears once a saved quote exists in the contractor's portfolio. The seeded contractor (anthony) had no pre-saved quotes at test time, so the Promote button was not visible in the UI smoke. Backend promote flow itself was validated end-to-end via pytest (test_full_promote_flow PASSED). Recommend main agent verify the Promote dropdown visually by manually creating + saving a quote in the UI.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all explicit checks: desktop+mobile /deliverable/demo, desktop+mobile /deck/demo, SKU Forecast tab visible+clickable+populated, Quote Builder loads catalog. Only caveat: Promote button itself was not visible because the test contractor had no saved quotes (backend API for promote flow is validated).
